  "fixes": [
    "Merge the 'Pokličite za šopek' contact section and the 'Obiščite nas' footer area so the address, directions link, and opening hours only appear once.",
    "Replace the repeated bouquet photo in the 'Lončnice in darilne košarice' section with an image that actually shows potted plants or gift baskets.",
    "Fix the primary button ('Darilne košarice') padding and remove its underline so the text sits centered inside the teal rectangle rather than hugging the left edge."
  ],

    "Both viewports, circular image badges: the 'Ustvarjeno z UI' label is clipped by the circular border crop on the inset photos."
  ]
